publicationSummaries.optimierung-von-knime-workflows-fur-big-: This study examines the selection and implementation of a system at Hubert Burda Media for combining, updating, and validating large datasets. It sets out requirements for transparent data cleaning and analysis, evaluates more than 50 products, and selects KNIME. It discusses local execution for data security, integration with the existing IT environment, interface requirements, and implementation challenges. One proposed design exports SAP R/3 data in one direction to Microsoft SQL Server, avoiding changes to SAP data while using an established service.
publicationSummaries.verantwortungsvoller-umgang-mit-kunstlic: This paper describes AI methods and their regulation, reviews existing frameworks, and considers their benefits and risks from a human-rights perspective. It calls for appropriate oversight to prevent misuse and greater public awareness of AI’s potential and risks, helping protect people from fraud and manipulation.
publicationSummaries.integration-eines-qualitatsmanagements-i: The publication outlines the processes, methods, and tools used to assure software quality throughout development. It covers monitoring and reviewing work from start to finish to meet customer requirements and reduce defects, highlighting testing as a key part of quality management.
publicationSummaries.kanban-system-zur-optimierung-von-produk: This paper explores combining Kanban systems with ERP software to make production and supply chains more sustainable and efficient. It explains material-flow monitoring and automatic identification for quality management, discusses the advantages and disadvantages of digitized Kanban, and draws on research in production, logistics, and capacity planning. The aim is to identify investment opportunities that can accelerate deliveries and reduce resource use.
publicationSummaries.digitale-zwillinge: The text describes how data and information processing shape everyday life, from smartphone sensors and location-based services to AI-generated profiles and language models. In manufacturing, robot arms generate data about their usage and condition; this information can be used to optimize operations and support digital representations of industrial equipment.
publicationSummaries.iterative-entwicklung-mit-versionsprotok: The publication presents iterative development and version control as a way to build software in small, regularly reviewed steps. Recording code changes makes it possible to trace work and return to earlier versions when problems arise. Continuous feedback and easier collaboration help improve product quality, maintain alignment with requirements, and increase reliability.
publicationSummaries.informationssicherheit-im-cloud-computin: This overview traces cloud computing from early ideas of providing IT resources as a service to modern shared infrastructure. It describes public, private, and hybrid cloud models, the flexibility and scalability offered by shared capacity, and the data-protection frameworks relevant to providers. It also outlines safeguards such as role-based access, encryption, network restrictions, VPNs, and malware checks.
publicationSummaries.risikomanagementprozesse: The paper explains how everyday business risks can arise from locations, hazardous materials, staffing, partners, technology, liquidity, and regulatory change. Risk-management systems help organizations analyze threats and establish preventive measures, while geopolitical events and global crises add uncertainty. It also discusses the growing importance of sustainable and socially responsible governance (ESG) in building resilience.
publicationSummaries.it-security-und-datenschutz: Using a medical practice as a context, this publication examines growing cyber threats as digital devices and services become more common. It presents availability, authorized access, and confidentiality as security goals, and argues that cybersecurity can create business value as well as meet compliance obligations. It describes the scale of cybercrime in Germany, risks to critical infrastructure and organizations, and attacks such as data theft, fraudulent executive emails, production disruption, and ransomware.
publicationSummaries.qualitatsmanagement-in-der-fertigenden-i: This paper explains how RFID can support automated processes and quality management in manufacturing. It considers ways to monitor production and identify items throughout operations so that organizations can maintain product quality and improve process control.
publicationSummaries.digitale-zahlen-als-dezimalzahlen-auf-ei: The text reviews the challenge of converting signals into readable information, from early approaches to displaying Morse code as alphanumeric characters to modern digital displays. Seven-segment displays can present decimal values for industrial warnings, changing prices, and instructions. Affordable LEDs have made displays common in clocks, calculators, appliances, and fuel-price signs.
publicationSummaries.analyse-gro-er-industrieller-datensatze: The publication describes how digital technology and sensors automate manufacturing tasks, monitor equipment, and help prevent defects. Industrial supply chains generate data across machines, suppliers, and transactions, but incompatible interfaces, formats, languages, and units make analysis difficult. Standardization and modern data processing can overcome these barriers, provide timely insight into equipment and logistics, and help control systems adapt production environments.
publicationSummaries.die-bestimmung-der-elementarladung: This text distinguishes electric current from the electrical energy shown on a household bill. Current is a physical quantity describing the amount of electric charge passing through a conductor’s cross-section per unit of time.
publicationSummaries.die-monopolstellung-von-flixbus-im-markt: The paper examines how FlixBus established itself in the long-distance coach market, including the history of passenger-transport legislation and the acquisition of other operators. It discusses how brand recognition and service quality contributed to market leadership, how ticket-price elasticity affects revenue, and how German and European authorities may respond to monopoly formation.
